summary: Reproduced both remaining counterexamples at candidate d38922c9: production configuration collapsed explicit FP8 E4M3/E5M2 to the host uint8 dtype, and UMBP omitted dtype from its prefix and direct-linker config. Preserved the candidate's valid fixes, keyed explicit formats from runtime configuration with an auto/device-dtype fallback, and completed UMBP propagation.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate d38922c9, E4M3/E5M2 both produced torch.uint8 in production storage config and UMBP produced identical test-model prefixes; two tests failed.

60 tests passed after correction, covering explicit E4M3/E5M2 separation despite a shared native FP8 dtype, auto fallback, direct UMBP config propagation, UMBP prefix isolation, candidate backend key paths, and hf3fs mock round trips.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defects are deterministic CPU-side configuration and key construction. No GPU result is claimed.

remaining_limitations: No external hf3fs, Mooncake, NIXL, EIC, UMBP, FlexKV, or LMCache service was available for end-to-end integration testing.
No model weights, serving run, or multi-node workload was used or claimed.
Mock clients validate namespace construction and local symmetry, not remote-service interoperability.
